usage.title: How to Use
items: D-Day Counter: Calculate days remaining until your target date
Date Difference: Show the period between two dates in various units
Date Add/Subtract: Add or subtract days from a specific date

businessDays.title: Business Days
businessDays.description: Business days exclude weekends (Sat, Sun) and Korean public holidays, including lunar calendar holidays like Seollal and Chuseok.

whatIs.title: What is the D-Day Calculator?
whatIs.description: A single tool that covers D-Day countdown to a specific date, calculating the difference between two dates, and adding or subtracting days from a date. Handles everything date-related — exam prep, travel planning, event coordination, contract expiry tracking, and more. Includes Korean public holiday data and supports business day calculations.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: On the D-Day tab, enter a name and date or tap a preset (CSAT, Seollal, Chuseok, Christmas) to see days left plus business days, weekends and holidays.
Save several D-Days and pin one so it opens first on your next visit.
On the Anniversary tab, enter the day you started dating, got married or your baby was born to see 100-day and yearly milestones.
Use Date difference and Add/Subtract for the span between two dates or the date N (business) days later.
Share, save the image or copy the link; whoever opens it sees the same D-Day.
If copying fails, select the complete snapshot or retry. You can cancel calendar preparation; start a new export after changing an event.

tips.title: Tips
items: Use business day mode for deadlines a contract sets in business days (e.g. 'within 10 business days'). Statutory periods such as filing a lawsuit or an objection in Korea count calendar days, and if the last day falls on a Saturday or public holiday the deadline moves to the next day (Civil Act Art. 161).
Register important dates — probation end dates, visa expiry, insurance renewal — as D-Days and bookmark them for easy reference.
Share a project deadline countdown with your team using the URL sharing feature.

items.q: How are D-1 and D-Day defined?
items.a: The target date itself is D-Day, the day before is D-1 and the day after is D+1. Today is computed in Korea Standard Time. Couple anniversaries often count the first day as day 1, so the Anniversary tab lets you choose.

items.q: Which years of Korean holidays are supported?
items.a: 2024-2050, including Seollal/Chuseok, substitute holidays, Labor Day and Constitution Day (public holidays since 2026), election days and temporary holidays. New temporary holidays are added after they are designated.
Yes. One year after Feb 29 is Feb 28, and one month after Jan 31 is the last day of February.

items.q: What can I do if copying fails?
items.a: Select the complete read-only snapshot of the clicked title, date, result and link, or explicitly retry copying. Editing another event or starting another export invalidates feedback from the earlier request.

items.q: What if I change an event while its calendar file is preparing?
items.a: Cancelling or changing the title, date, selected events or language invalidates the older download request. Start a new export for the current content. Export the current event or up to 100 selected saved events as all-day ICS; importing the file into a calendar is a separate action.

calendarExport.title: Export a calendar file
calendarExport.description: Download the current D-day or selected saved events as an .ics file, then import it into your calendar app.
calendarExport.savedUnavailable: The saved list cannot be verified. Check the notice under Saved D-days and reload the list. You can still export the current D-day separately.
calendarExport.emptySaved: No saved events. Save the current D-day to make it available here.
calendarExport.selectEvents: Choose saved events for calendar export
calendarExport.scope: Includes one all-day event on each selected date. No recurrence or alarms are added, and nothing is sent automatically to a calendar account.
calendarExport.importHint: Exporting the same saved event again uses the same identifier. Calendar apps may update an existing event or add a duplicate when reimporting, so check the import result.

errors.empty: Select at least one saved event to export.
errors.tooMany: A file can contain up to 100 events. Reduce your selection. No partial file was created.
errors.invalidDate: An invalid date prevented export. Check that each date is a real date between years 0100 and 9999.
errors.endDate: December 31, 9999 cannot be exported because its next-day end date is outside the supported year range. Remove that event or change its date. No other selected events were exported.
errors.invalidTitle: An event title is empty or contains unsupported characters or length. Titles may contain up to 2,000 characters, without control or broken Unicode characters. No text was silently changed or removed.
errors.invalidId: An invalid event identifier prevented export. Check the saved list.
errors.duplicate: The same event was selected more than once. Clear the selection and select again.
errors.selectionChanged: A selected event changed or disappeared from the saved list. Clear the selection and check the list again. No partial file was created.
errors.timestamp: The file creation time could not be verified. Check your device’s date and time, then try again.
errors.download: The calendar file could not be created or downloaded. Current inputs and saved events are unchanged. Check your browser’s download settings and try again.
errors.savedCorrupt: The saved list contains unreadable entries. The original data is preserved and writes are paused. You can still calculate and export the current D-day.
errors.savedUnsupported: This saved format is unsupported. The original data is preserved and writes are paused. You can still calculate and export the current D-day.
errors.savedUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. The save operation did not complete. Your current inputs are unchanged.
errors.savedQuota: Storage is full, so changes could not be saved. The previous list and current inputs are unchanged. Free up space and reload the list.
errors.savedConflict: Another tab changed the saved list, so this action was stopped. Your current inputs are unchanged. Reload the list and try again.

exportActions.failed: Automatic copying failed. Select the full text to copy it manually, or try again.
exportActions.field: Event result and link to copy
exportActions.selectionFailed: Automatic selection failed. Select the text manually.
exportActions.cancelled: File preparation was cancelled. Your selected events are kept.
exportActions.scopeHint: Changing the date or title, or starting another export, cancels the earlier file preparation. Click again for the events you need.
